SCI2_TDR.policy: Write only after TDRE read1; byte is transmitted only after qualified TDRE-clear transition

SCI2_RDR.policy: Read only; read alone does not clear RDRF

SCI2_SDCR.meaning: DIR0, LSB first; high nibble1, bit2/0 zero, bit1 reads1

WDT_TCSR.meaning: A5 key; reserved bits18; TME0, interval mode0, clock select0. Read before write also allows OVF clear.

DMAOR.meaning: Read then write0, readback DME0; zero also clears read AE/NMIF. Never re-enable.

RAMER.meaning: RAMS1 overlays4KiB RAM into low flash; lower3 select page only if RAMS1

FMATS.meaning: AA means user boot MAT; other values select user MAT. Accept0 only is a conservative additional constraint.

sci.format: 8 data bits, no parity, one stop bit, LSB first, asynchronous internal clock, polling, no SCI interrupts
initialization_order: FFFF3086: PCCR preserves documented unrelated bits and selects SCI2 pins
FFFF308A..308C: 2048-iteration loop, at least4096 instructions for BRR settle
FFFF308E..30A0: read-before-clear receive/error flags and optionally drain stale RDR
FFFF30A4: SCR10 receive-only; TE remains disabled until a validated response
status_rules: TDRE/RDRF/ORER/FER/PER accept zero only after reading that bit1; software cannot set these flags1
SCR.TE0 forces TDRE/TEND1; receive errors survive RE0
Writing TDR alone is not a complete transmission trigger
TDRE read1 -> TDR write -> SSR TDRE0 submits one byte, clears TEND; shift-register load sets TDRE; final character completion sets TEND
Read SSR.RDRF1 -> read RDR -> clear RDRF; clearing without reading RDR discards current byte
SSR error bits20/10/08 require visible error handling, not accepting corrupt request bytes
TEND and MPB are read-only; write must not fabricate either bit
sci.selected_wait_contract: RK02 bounds TX-ready and final TEND waits to65536 polling iterations with terminal failure. RX idle and partial-frame waits are deliberately unbounded read-only polling; the host deadline and independently verified physical power loss terminate a stalled session. No whole-session wall-clock bound is claimed. Initial16us lower bound follows final instruction count and explicit CPU<=80MHz assumption.
sci.exit_transmit: Drain final reply through TEND before intentional SCI quiet state; timeout means reply incomplete, never success.
response_order: SCR20 before any response TDR write; RE0 prevents new receive-start admission
Read SSR; residual RDRF/ORER/FER/PER mask78 terminates with SCR0 before TDR
Read TDRE1, write TDR, clear observed TDRE per character
After final checksum submission, poll TEND within65536 iterations; both buffered and shifting TX must finish
Write SCR10 only after TEND; accept a new request under receive-only state
After two passes and canary checks, SCR0 terminal quiet
sci.echo_boundary: An echo that starts under RE0 is ignored even if its completion would be after RX restoration. A genuinely new delayed start after RE1 is new input and may fail the parser; unbounded physical delay tolerance is not claimed.
sci.failure_transmit: Terminal failures may disable TE with an incomplete response. This is not success; host retains partial evidence and does not retry.

new_kernel_requirements: Establish SR=F0 and private aligned SP before C or stack-consuming calls
Install fully initialized, four-byte-aligned private VBR table before accepting requests
No FPU or inherited register/RAM predicates; initialize every private mutable state before reading
Disable DMAC and on-chip WDT early; do not infer any initial peripheral value from reset defaults
Only read explicit ROM range0..FFFFF after RAMER and FMATS guards
Every exception vector used by the design reaches private fail-closed handler; no OEM return/resume
entry.exception_limit: NMI priority16 cannot be masked by SR.I15. Private handler can reset SP and halt; no claim covers an arbitrarily rapid sequence of NMIs before its first SP-reset instruction.
entry.no_shared_OEM_RAM_needed: Private RAM takeover is for a stopped programming session only; it does not preserve running OEM state. Successful restart requires real reset/power restoration, not a jump into clobbered RAM.

forbidden.no_external_executable_targets: No OEM calls, on-chip flash algorithm download, targetsFFFF0010/FFFF0020/FFFF1010/FFFF1020, arbitrary call/poke or code selected by host.
forbidden.closed_world_MMIO: Everything not specifically admitted is unsupported. GPIO PBDR/PDDR/FWE toggles, peripheral output control, MAT writes and RAMER writes are excluded.

physical_or_entry_assumptions: The exact selected ECU supports the fixed stock-loader contract; current-ROM identity is not inferred from a CAL ID alone.
Stable powered SH7058 with enabled on-chip RAM and compatible clock: Pphi20MHz is inferred from known BRR9/62500 behavior, not measured on this vehicle.
No asynchronous NMI/reset/address fault corrupts the prefix before private SP/VBR become active.
No prior or in-flight DMA/other bus master has corrupted upload/stack before DME0 takes effect; the kernel can stop future DMA but cannot undo prior writes.
External watchdog, power-management IC and board wiring are not controlled or qualified merely by disabling the on-chip WDT. DUAL toggles PBDR bit15; its board role is not proven.
UART virtual timing, fake provider success and instruction budgets do not prove actual baud/electrical/host timing.
No autonomous OEM restart. Ignition OFF alone is not yet evidence of ECU supply or RAM loss; verify actual power loss and subsequent reset/OEM identity.
changed_scope: SCI receive-only initialization and per-response half-duplex sequencing. Other documented peripheral/entry assumptions retained; prior contract remains unchanged as RK01 evidence.
